chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the repeated verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as addressing both humans and jinn, highlighting the dual nature of creation's gratitude. The repetition underscores the overwhelming abundance of divine favors, serving as a rhetorical challenge to deny what is visibly manifest. This verse encapsulates the core theme of Surah Ar-Rahman, linking cosmic blessings to moral accountability.
